No, it did not take more than a week for Adam to remind LiHua about the contractor team installing the air-conditioner. According to the conversation, Adam first inquired about the possibility of adding an air-conditioner in the basement on July 16th at 10:00 AM (record 2). LiHua expressed interest in having one installed, and Adam mentioned he would check with the maintenance department and get back to her (record 2). 

Then, on August 10th at 18:00, Adam followed up with LiHua regarding the warranty and maintenance plans for the air-conditioner (record 4). Therefore, the delay from Adam asking about the air-conditioner to reminding LiHua about the installation date was less than a week.
